_note: Per-plane 3D orientation for the 13 shot-scale planes, assigned by ROLE, at 1x. Units are dz per SOURCE pixel; these planes are shot-scale (2.34x smaller than master), so equivalent recession needs ~2.34x the per-pixel value the master-scale geometry.json used. A ground plane ~350px tall receding 0.10 of depth is tiltX 0.000286.

_roles.floor: tiltX negative — pitches away as it rises up the picture. Water surfaces, paths, decks. This is the plane whose flatness a dolly exposes first.
_roles.wall: tiltY — yaws away across width. Cliff faces turning out of frame.
_roles.billboard: absent from this file. Figures and foliage are genuinely flat objects seen face-on; tilting them is what produced skewing cutouts.
